sections.heading: Glossary term: Distance Ladder
sections.body: One of the key foundations of understanding the Universe is to determine distances to various objects and phenomena. Understanding distances allows scientists to not only map the observable Universe, but also understand the physical properties of various objects and phenomena. The distance ladder, often called the cosmic distance ladder, is a framework that provides an overview of the various techniques that are used to measure distances across a range of scales. Just like rungs of a ladder, each rung (measurement technique) of the distance ladder is calibrated based on the previous rung. The ladder starts with measurement techniques that can be used for objects that are closer (e.g. parallax), and each proceeding rung allows scientists to measure more distant objects (e.g. Type Ia supernovae, redshift).

Glossary term: Distance Ladder

Description: One of the key foundations of understanding the Universe is to determine distances to various objects and phenomena. Understanding distances allows scientists to not only map the observable Universe, but also understand the physical properties of various objects and phenomena. The distance ladder, often called the cosmic distance ladder, is a framework that provides an overview of the various techniques that are used to measure distances across a range of scales. Just like rungs of a ladder, each rung (measurement technique) of the distance ladder is calibrated based on the previous rung. The ladder starts with measurement techniques that can be used for objects that are closer (e.g. parallax), and each proceeding rung allows scientists to measure more distant objects (e.g. Type Ia supernovae, redshift).

Related Terms:

  • Annual Parallax
  • Cepheid Variable
  • Cosmology
  • Parallax
  • Redshift

See this term in other languages

Term and definition status: This term and its definition have been approved by a research astronomer and a teacher

The OAE Multilingual Glossary is a project of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Education (OAE) in collaboration with the IAU Office of Astronomy Outreach (OAO). The terms and definitions were chosen, written and reviewed by a collective effort from the OAE, the OAE Centers and Nodes, the OAE National Astronomy Education Coordinators (NAECs) and other volunteers. You can find a full list of credits here. All glossary terms and their definitions are released under a Creative Commons CC BY-4.0 license and should be credited to "IAU OAE".

sections.body_ru: Одной из ключевых основ понимания Вселенной является определение расстояний до различных объектов и явлений. Знание расстояний позволяет учёным не только картографировать наблюдаемую Вселенную, но и понимать физические свойства различных объектов и явлений. Лестница расстояний, часто называемая космической лестницей расстояний, представляет собой систему различных методов измерения расстояний на разных масштабах. Каждая ступень (метод измерения) лестницы расстояний калибруется на основе предыдущей ступени. Лестница начинается с методов измерения, которые можно использовать для более близких объектов (например, параллакс), и каждая последующая ступень позволяет учёным измерять расстояния до более далёких объектов (например, с помощью сверхновых типа Ia или красного смещения).
